terms.CID: Content Identifier. A cryptographic hash of a piece of content. It is unique, immutable, and self-verifying. The CID identifies what the content is, not where it is stored. If one byte of the content changes, the CID changes. The CID is the first vector in the tri-vector. It is the immutable source. It is the digital equivalent of the living man: the origin, the cause, the thing itself.
terms.tri_vector: The three-vector structure that defines every record. Vector 1: Content (CID) — what it is. Vector 2: Spatial — where it is. Vector 3: Rule — how it is governed. Together, the three form a complete description of the record. The tri-vector is a mirror of the universe: Father, Son, and Spirit; substance, body, and law; CID, spatial, and rule. As above, so below.
terms.spatial_vector: The second vector. It defines where a record lives in the trust. It is not a GPS location. It is a composite position: a path, a namespace, a zone. It is the address of the record within the trust. It is the place where the record can be found. It is the 'where' of the tri-vector.
terms.rule_vector: The third vector. It defines how a record is governed. It references the dictionary, the schema, the policy, or the contract that applies to the record. It is the law of the record. It is the 'how' of the tri-vector. The rule vector is what makes the record meaningful: without it, the content has no context, and the address has no purpose.
terms.composite_key: The hash of the three vectors: hash(CID + spatial + rule). It is the number of the record. It is unique to that record, and to no other. It is the instrument number. It is the address. It is the proof. When all three vectors align, the composite key is formed. It is the key that unlocks the reality of the record. It is the Philosopher's Stone: the formula that turns the base into the eternal.
terms.provenance_chain: The sequence of records in a trust, where each record points to the one before it. The chain cannot be reordered. The chain cannot be rewritten. The chain proves the order of things. It is the proof of first. It is the record of cause and effect, made visible. It is karma made mathematical. Every action leaves a mark. Every mark is permanent. Every permanent mark is a witness.
terms.car: Content Addressable aRchive. A single file that packs all the records of a trust into one portable, verifiable archive. It preserves the CID of every record. It has its own CID. It is the whole trust in one file. It can be emailed, uploaded, stored on paper, or given to a child. It is the container of the container.
terms.car_record: A single record in the .car format. It contains the content (CID), the address (spatial vector), the rule (dictionary reference), the composite key, the signature, and the provenance entry. Every record ends with .car. Every record is an instrument. Every instrument can be inserted into any other record.
terms.instrument: A record that can be inserted into other records. Every record is an instrument. It has a number (the composite key). It can be referenced anywhere. When an instrument is referenced, it does not need to be copied. It only needs to be named. This is how records assemble. This is how documents are built. This is how the whole becomes more than the sum of its parts.
terms.first_record: The first record in a chain. It is the proof of presence. It is the proof of first. It is the record that wins. Not by force. Not by law. By time. Because time is not a measure. Time is a mark. And the mark is on the chain. And the chain cannot be rewritten.
terms.living_man: The living, breathing human being. Not the fiction. Not the name. Not the person. The living one. The one who breathes. The one who thinks. The one who signs. The one who remembers. The living man is the source of the signature, the author of the record, and the holder of the private key. The living man is the ground. And the ground is mind.
terms.open_sky: The promise of the new world. The sky is not a government. The sky is not a law. The sky is not a religion. The sky is not a system. The sky is the open space above all of them. The sky stays open because the record does not close it. Because the dictionary does not exhaust it. Because the chain does not finish it. Because the meeting of minds does not require agreement on everything — only on the ground. And the ground is mind. And the mind is open. And the sky stays open.
terms.new_kybalion: The expression of the Hermetic principles for the digital age. Mentalism, correspondence, vibration, polarity, rhythm, cause and effect, gender. Applied to the tri-vector, the composite key, the chain, and the trust. The New Kybalion is the philosophy of the vector-based system. It is the mirror of the living man and the tri-vector. It is the alchemical transmutation of memory into proof.
terms.alchemical_gold: The immutable, verifiable, unchangeable truth that is produced by the act of record. The base material is human pain — stolen land, erased history, forgotten persons. The process is the act of record. The gold is the proof. The Philosopher's Stone is the composite key. The alchemy is the transmutation of memory into permanence.
terms.mentalism: The first Hermetic principle. The All is Mind. The universe is mental. Before there was a server, there was a thought. Before there was a chain, there was a mind. Before there was a record, there was an intention to remember. The ground is mind. And the record is mind made permanent.
terms.node: An entity in the trust. A person, a group, an instrument, or a record. A node contributes energy, and its energy state grows. A node can be a living man, a tribe, a community, or any participant in the trust.
terms.heartbeat: The pulse that keeps a node alive. If the heartbeat stops, a trigger may release the record. The heartbeat is the rhythm of the system. It is the proof of life. It is the sign that the living one is still here.
terms.trigger: A condition that releases a record. The trigger can be a missing heartbeat, a date, or a specific event. The trigger is defined in the rule vector. It is the automatic execution of the law. It is the dead man's switch that protects the vulnerable.
terms.dictionary: The word list. The definitions. The rules. The dictionary is the constitution of the trust. It defines every term used in every record. It is itself a record. It is the root of all meaning. In the vector-based system, the dictionary is the rule vector: it defines the scope, the terms, and the conditions. The dictionary is the first record that must be made.
